title: Heather S NDE 194
content: I flipped, hit my head and landed in the water. I don't remember hitting the deck though (that's what I was told) I just remember standing on the deck and then I felt like I was being spun around, not knowing which way was up. Then there was a instant calm, I looked up and there was this light that looked almost like I was looking down a wave of surf or a 'tunnel'. I saw at the end what look to be a beach, grass, and a man standing there, I could hear him tell me that I wasn't supposed to be there yet. He didn't talk, but I knew what he was saying. At the same time, I could also see the pool, like I was above it, about twenty feet or so, looking straight down at myself. Then I felt myself going through the 'tunnel' but then I heard my brother's voice and I was 'snapped back' into by body. My brother said it happened very fast, like within a minute, but it seemed to be much longer. Since that time I have had OBE's and several dreams about drowning and coming walking out of the water, onto a beach and having this man (who I decided was Jesus) walking up to him and having him tell me to go back. I also have had several 'visions' of seeing other people who are drowning.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death I did a back-flip off of the deck into our pool and hit the back of my head and fell into the pool. My brother said I 'blacked out for a little while' (more like a minute or so).
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I know I wasn't in my body simply because I could breath, I was looking down on the scene.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I remember being confused at first, but quickly I became very alert and remember the experience very clearly even today.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The experience lasted just a minute but it seemed to last several, if not hours. It was like time wasn't even real.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Wind, a calm wind and a tone (I sometimes still here this out of the blue).
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was a tunnel made up of this warm embracing light. I didn't have to think about moving through it, I just did.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw a man standing on the beach at the end of the tunnel looking at me. I believe it to be Jesus; he told me I wasn't supposed to be there yet, that he had a mission for me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light from the tunnel, it glowed.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The beach I saw, I know was not located on Earth, I just knew, and still know.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Scared then, during the experience, a calm wonderful warm feeling. I can't really describe it. Like I was being hugged by very big arms.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe But that is not to be disclosed right now.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I'm not sure, I didn't see events, I felt them. When I came out of it, I began to do certain things, and they are still getting stronger to this day. Yes I did learn things, but that information is for me.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I have been able to see glimpses of future events (usually 48-72 hours before they happen) I don't really keep up with the news but I would have to say the percentage is around ninety-five percent if not one hundred percent have come true. But there is more to that I wish not to say right now.

elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes More than I wish, I will describe in detail, if asked later.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best part was that feeling, the one I described as getting hugged above. The worst part was at the beginning, when I was confused.
